gamerule.propwash.allow_freecam.descript: On: players can fly a free camera drone that exists only on their own screen – no collision, no model, no battery. It reaches only the area their game has loaded and can look through walls. Off by default. Modified clients can ignore this setting.
propwash.freecam.title: Freecam · %s
propwash.freecam.preset.whoop.tip: Tiny indoor whoop – slow and nimble.
propwash.freecam.preset.7.tip: 7″ long range – heavy, fast and smooth.
propwash.freecam.uptilt.tip: Camera tilt for this size. Each size keeps its own angle.
propwash.freecam.fov.tip: Horizontal field of view of the freecam, the same for all sizes (default 120°).
propwash.freecam.osd.tip: Show the flight OSD in the freecam.
propwash.freecam.hint: Rates, receiver and modes are in the other tabs. Rates and camera angle are kept per size. Armed, the freecam flies; disarmed, it parks in the air.
propwash.freecam.footer: Saved for the freecam only – rates and camera angle per size
propwash.freecam.denied: The freecam drone is turned off in this world (world rule).
propwash.freecam.denied.unknown: The freecam drone is not available here: the server sends no world rules.
propwash.freecam.denied.dead: The freecam can't start while you are dead.
propwash.freecam.ended.rule: Freecam ended: turned off by a world rule.
propwash.freecam.ended.piloting: Freecam ended: your drone flight started.
propwash.freecam.intro: Arm to fly (%1$s), %2$s for settings, %3$s to return.
